description:
## Objective

Add executable examples for current Flow execution forms.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U10`
Covers: `R1, R2, R4; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD6, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.8 (U8) — Add the example catalog harness must be complete; jido-07x.5 (U5) — Port Action and Flow property checks must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.20 (U20) — Enforce quality gates in CI and agent guidance must be complete.

## Files

Read `../refs/jido_action/examples/02_execution/**` and matching tests at Action commit `40ec1f0af3a373bae5e6d869017cc229c85aef92`. Add `examples/flow/execution/**` and `test/examples/flow/execution/**`. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port all 15 numbered execution examples.
2. Preserve serial, parallel, choice, collection, iteration, child, wait, control, failure, and dynamic invoke behavior.
3. Use deterministic fixtures and explicit result assertions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 15 source example IDs have a manifest disposition.
- [ ] Every ported example has one paired offline test.
- [ ] Wait and parallel examples use deterministic coordination.

## Verification

- `mix test.examples test/examples/flow/execution` exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Completed in 545eee2. Added 15 numbered Flow execution lessons under examples/flow/02_execution with mirrored tests and individual source-manifest records. Wait tests use Jido.Exec.Test.WaitHost. Parallel tests use message barriers. Current API deviations: child Flow proof uses the compiled component, controlled execution uses Runic.Runner manual dispatch, and Action continuation tuples are asserted as unsupported. No assets were deferred. Verification: focused U10 16 passed before the path migration; combined numbered U9/U10 27 passed; catalog 8 passed; full examples 35 passed; manifest 6 passed; compile warnings, format, and diff checks passed.

title: Port Action execution examples
